First, I need to identify which structure held the record immediately before the Burj Khalifa. According to the table, the Burj Khalifa has held the record from 2007 to the present. The structure that held the record before 2007 is the one listed with the "Held record" ending in 2007.

Looking at the "Held record" column:
- CN Tower: 1976–2007
- Burj Khalifa: 2007–present

So, the CN Tower held the record from 1976 until 2007, when the Burj Khalifa took over.

Final Answer: CN Tower
